purpose: The only authority that may hold the web-server-integration CI leg at not_run. The gate recomputes, from the committed bytes, the unavailability codes this leg can be held at, and may print a not_run receipt only when that recomputed set is exactly the set registered here - compared in both directions. A code the gate computes but this file does not name, or a code named here that is no longer true, makes the leg run instead.
review_policy: review_by is an expiry: scripts/verify-ci-leg-receipts.mjs fails the leg once the date has passed, so a registration cannot outlive its review. Every entry must carry a reason, the recomputed codes it names, a trigger that names what would remove it, an owner and a review_by date.

entries.object: the pinned Web Server exercised with the published public reference asset through the package's own published client entry
entries.trigger: a published reference asset whose exact bytes the committed public Core admits is supplied through KDNA_WEB_CLIENT_ASSET AND tests/web-server-integration.test.js drives the package's published client entry (then the leg runs `npm run test:web-server-integration` for real and its exit status becomes the leg's)
